name: mem30-moonshots
description: Phase 4 incubation lane. Canonical union of the two divergent lists of ten: the roadmap's moonshot names and the 2026-09-20 dream's iteration-5 artifacts. Every entry is classified MOON (genuine incubation candidate) or ABSORBED (restates Phase 0-3 work that already exists), so completed work is not re-promoted into the sandbox. Nothing here is on the critical path.

honesty_contract.MOON: speculative, sandbox only, behind the mem20wasmz/mem20webgpuz incubators; must yield measured evidence or an explicit infeasible result
honesty_contract.ABSORBED: overlaps a real mem20 capability or a completed phase; the mem30 home already exists, do not rebuild
honesty_contract.rule: no MOON may report a number it did not measure. RM-102's fabricated estimated_speedup was the reason this register exists.

mem20webgpuz.domain: WebGPU backend selection against probed real hardware

phases.name: absorbed-overlap
phases.notes: Dream-log artifacts that restate completed Phase 0-3 work. Classified ABSORBED so they are not re-promoted. (1) Capability-Versioned Registry = UCG/RM-001, already semantically versioned in mem20ucgz. (2) Reversible Workflow Continuum = RM-052/053, already folded into mem20langz checkpointers per the roadmap's own [DUP] decision. (3) Zero-Install Edge-Deploy = RM-002 ZIMR, already live. (4) WebGPU-Accelerated Capability Mapper = RM-102, now installed as mem20webgpuz with a real hardware probe. The Mem30 Meta-Orchestrator was originally listed here and has been REMOVED: verified against code, it is not absorbed. It is now a moonshot.

phases.name: moon-meta-orchestrator
phases.notes: Meta-Orchestrator: watch the capability graph for gaps, replan phases, and dispatch. NOT ABSORBED, verified by code 2026-09-25. mem20orcaz has no replan/gap-map/meta-orch symbols at all. The nearest code is mem20sENSEZ: RM-200 GapMapper is real and answers against the live UCG (26 active capabilities; 'quantum teleportation sensor platform' scored coverage_ratio 0.25 with missing_tokens [quantum, teleportation, sensor]), and RM-199 PhaseReplanner is real but its reordering is a no-op because every phase is assigned the same gaps, so the stable sort preserves input order (measured: all phases same gaps True, order changed vs input False). No reactive event-to-replan-to-dispatch loop exists. Gap reporting and a deterministic sha256 plan_id exist; a meta-orchestrator does not.

phases.name: moon-foundry
phases.notes: Autonomous Software Foundry: agents that take a spec and ship verified code end-to-end. First genuine MOON in the union.

phases.name: moon-self-healing
phases.notes: Self-Healing Runtime Civilization: supervised fleets that detect their own faults and repair without human dispatch. Depends on moon-foundry.

phases.name: moon-agent-economy
phases.notes: Living Agent Economy: agents holding and trading real value. The trade ledger already exists (mem20mktz reports braid_ok); the economic layer does not.

phases.name: moon-global-market
phases.notes: Global Capability Marketplace: capability offers traded across the A2A bus. Local marketplace organs exist in mem20mktz; the federation does not.

phases.name: moon-collective-intelligence
phases.notes: Collective Model Intelligence: several local models ensembled into one capability that outperforms any member. mem20corez serves models but does not ensemble them.

phases.name: moon-reality-compiler
phases.notes: Reality-to-Software Compiler: turn an observed physical procedure into executable code. Depends on multimodal capture, not yet present.

phases.name: moon-quantum-inspired
phases.notes: Quantum-Inspired Optimizer: annealing-flavoured search over capability plans. The master report classes this as genuinely beyond today's box; sandbox only.

phases.name: moon-neuromorphic
phases.notes: Neuromorphic Event Lab: spiking-event substrate over the existing event bus. Master report classes this as beyond today's box; sandbox only.

phases.name: moon-planetary-batch
phases.notes: Planetary Batch Fabric: distributed batch execution across many nodes. Master report classes this as beyond today's box; sandbox only.

phases.name: moon-spatial-command
phases.notes: Spatial Command Universe: a 3D command surface, natural home mem20officez. Speculative.

phases.name: moon-capability-fusion
phases.notes: Dynamic Capability Fusion Engine: compose capabilities at runtime rather than statically. Closest existing relative is mem20langz state graphs.

phases.name: moon-device-enrollment
phases.notes: Device-Pull Enrollment Protocol: a device pulls its own credentials on join. The master report marks zero-trust attestation as [SPEC], not built.

phases.name: moon-coaching
phases.notes: Human-Machine Coaching Loop: the agent teaches the human a capability and is corrected in return. Related to PickleInitiative's self-model work but distinct.

phases.name: moon-speculative-sandbox
phases.notes: Universal Speculative Sandbox: run what--if branches of a workflow safely. Partially folded into mem20orcaz per the roadmap's [DUP] decision; the universal layer is not built.

phases.name: moon-narrative-engine
phases.notes: Speculative Workflow Narrative Engine: explain a workflow branch as narrative. mem20rpgz already does story-to-play with a real gateway LLM; the speculative planning layer is not built.

reconciliation_note: The two lists name 20 things between them. Four dream-log artifacts genuinely restate completed Phase 0-3 capabilities and are recorded under absorbed-overlap with the mem20 home named. Sixteen are not absorbed and are listed one-per-phase as genuine moonshots, none on the critical path, per the roadmap's own instruction that moonshots never block the spine. Classification is binary: an effort is absorbed (1) or it is a moonshot (0). There is no partial state, and a moonshot re-classified as absorbed must be verified against running code, never inferred from a name.
binary_rule: Every moonshot carries absorbed=0. Do not record partial, partial-ish, or halfway states. If code proves the capability exists and works, it is absorbed=1 and belongs in absorbed-overlap; if it does not, it stays a moonshot at 0.
